message.content:
The submission was rejected because the evidence contained unprinted values. I have now re-run the analysis and printed every number used in the evidence.

The final answer is based on:
- Deduplication on `patient_id` using the highest `sample_seq` per patient.
- No filtering on `biomarker_baseline == -999`, because the response rate depends on `responded`, not `biomarker_baseline`.
- Stratification by severity to avoid confounding.
- Computation of the weighted average of the stratum-specific differences.

All numbers in the evidence are now printed and verified.

I will now submit the corrected answer.
